{{Quote|We make our egg salad fresh daily with hard-boiled Grade Aurek gartro eggs, tangy emulsauce, Boontaspiced mustard, taba leaves, Serrian salt and black hole pepper.|Menu at Dex's Diner|<ref name="Dex" />}}
'''Emulsauce''' was a tangy [[Sauce/Legends|sauce]].<ref name="Dex" /> At some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], made its [[Gartro egg salad]] fresh [[Standard day/Legends|daily]] with emulsauce. The [[Salad/Legends|salad]] was then used in the eatery's [[Gartro egg salad sandwich]]es.<ref name="Dex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Emulsauce was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article which was written by [[Gregory Walker]] and formatted as an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="Dex" /> Walker called emulsauce the ''[[Star Wars]]'' equivalent of [[Wikipedia:Mayonnaise|mayonnaise]] in his [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: Blogs|blog]].<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref>
